prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Predictions generally overestimate noise-corrected results, though some winning tests (like adoption new_screen) exceeded expectations.
No clear effect was seen for home, wait_info changes across four tests.
No clear effect was seen for choose_path, hint changes across two tests.
No clear effect was seen for choose_path, layout changes across two tests.
Evidence for sign_in, copy, sign_in, reorder, and adoption, redesign changes remains thin because results contradict each other or lack consistent wins.
Evidence for single-test change kinds (adoption layout/new_screen, finish changes, home notification/new_flow) remains thin.

Changes:
0: [finish, new_screen] Desktop pet sound test step on onboarding completion: Add a new pet sound test screen after home intro to introduce voice interactions before desktop launch. (why: Finish conversion drops to 64.8% and support received 3 emails from users confused about how to talk to or interact with their pet.)
1: [sign_in, reorder] Reorder sign in immediately after adoption certificate: Move sign-in to trigger immediately after signing the adoption certificate, right before background waiting initializes. (why: Placing sign-in after adoption certificate secures the pet profile when emotional investment is highest before background waiting.)
2: [finish, layout] Compact desktop launch checklist on home intro: Switch home intro screen layout to compact checklist mode highlighting key desktop shortcuts. (why: Finish screen conversion is low at 64.8% with 395s median time; a compact checklist streamlines desktop activation.)
3: [finish, incentive] Desktop companion badge on finish screen: Display an active desktop companion badge on the home intro screen as a reward for completing setup. (why: Overall onboarding completion is only 23.0%, with finish step showing high mean drop time (5815s).)
4: [home, hint] Desktop taskbar render troubleshooting hint: Add a hint on the waiting screen explaining how pet rendering overlays above system taskbar windows. (why: 3 support tickets reported the pet not appearing on desktop or app failing to open during initialization.)
5: [home, wait_info] Audio chime progress indicator on waiting screen: Add a subtle sound component and progress update to the waiting screen as desktop pet engine initializes. (why: Home / waiting step has a long median time of 201s and mean of 2336s, causing user dropout.)
6: [home, notification] Taskbar ready background notification prompt: Enable notify_when_ready on the waiting screen so users get a native notification when the pet finishes rendering. (why: Users take median 201s / mean 2336s on waiting screen and 3 users reported confusion over desktop visibility.)
